items.title: Wilbur DeParis Interview, 1959-06-26
items.q: I notice you've played with Duke Ellington... I used to use a plunger... with Duke

ctx.x: did you ever use a plunger?
yes I used to but not with I didn't with Duke I used to use a plunger in fact Sidney and I both Sidney still used a plunger but when I was younger I used to use a plunger quite a bit
I think that just about finishes the tape now doesn't it?
